description: Find workplace safety standards (29 CFR sections) by section number or by words in the title, such as "1910.14", "lockout", "fall protection" or "forklift". Returns up to 10 standards cited at least 50 times since 2016, most cited first, with headline figures and a link.

query.description: A section number or prefix, or words from the section title.

name: search_standards
title: Search safety standards
